values: One native region includes Mashhad, Nishapur, Sabzevar, Bojnurd and Birjand. Bayat, Kurdish and Arab district rulers were autonomous; a single AFH is not uniform Shahrokh administration. No Herat, Sistan or later Qajar territory annexed.
Check Mashhad capital and Shahrokh. Separate district borders would require a later focused choice, not invented ethnic conversions.

Native Durrani independence guarantee represents external protection after Ahmad Shah settlements and dynastic marriage. No annexation, payments, permanent alliance or vassal status. Initialization Jan1776 and one-year binding are mechanical, not an authenticated treaty transcript.
Check Timur Shah, directed DUR to AFH guarantee, influence cost and diplomacy after one month.
Shahrokh remains ruler. Nader Mirza exercised power in Mashhad after Nasrallah left in1775. No fictional unified Afghan-appointed governor or new army invented. Age41 reflects birth-year1734 only.
Inspect ruler and hereditary government. Native generated heir or future succession is not a scripted historical reconstruction.

Agha Mohammad is at Shiraz, not a shah of united Iran. Hosayn Qoli, Zand-appointed Damghan governor, contested northern districts. Kondo, Orient25 (1989), pp124–128, stresses conflicting chronicle sequences and contested Astarabad. No credible single whole-region transfer identified for Jan1.
Borders retained, not certified as uniformly direct Zand administration. Future narrow local decision only; do not give all Mazandaran to Agha Mohammad.
